Analysis: Hypothesis 2 provides a more defined and plausible framework by focusing on a well-known tumor type (NSCLC) and clear immunological endpoints (CD8+ T cells) following radiotherapy. While both hypotheses exhibit novelty, Hypothesis 1 introduces more novel elements such as systemic reprogramming and the role of Ter cells, yet suffers from issues of mechanistic ambiguity and less clarity regarding cellular actors, which could complicate safety and testability. In contrast, Hypothesis 2, despite needing further mechanistic elaboration, is more readily testable in established NSCLC models and aligns better with known immunotherapy paradigms, improving its likelihood for safe translation.
